en: The image shows a picturesque coastal town with several fishing boats docked in a harbor. The background is filled with tightly-packed buildings climbing up a hill, with a mix of residential and commercial architecture. On the hill, there is a prominent structure that looks like a fort or a significant building surrounded by greenery. The water in the foreground is calm, reflecting the boats and the buildings. The lower left corner of the postcard features the text 'Biblioteca de Galicia'.
